prompts.name: Provider Depot
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: high-resolution concept artwork for Jat'z Distribution, a Factorio freighter logistics depot.
Create one original industrial depot as a complete isolated object on a genuinely transparent background. Square 1536x1536 or higher resolution. Orthographic three-quarter view, camera elevation 45 degrees, front and right face visible, fixed soft sunlight from upper left. Compact square armored foundation whose intended ground footprint is 3 by 3 game tiles. All equipment fits within the square ground footprint. Keep 10 percent clear margin around the entire object. No road, truck, people, scenery, lettering, labels, watermark, or layout sheet.
Style derived from the Yuoki containers and tanks inspected in this conversation and the approved Quinityn armored freighter. Dense realistic industrial 3D concept rendering, sharp functional mechanical detail, dark charcoal cast-steel structure, broad bolted chamfered corner armor, muted slate metal panels, copper/brass fittings and burnt-orange latch hardware. Heavy believable material thickness, worn bright edges, small chipped paint, rust in fasteners and welds, greasy seams, broader handling scuffs. Balanced wear with strong readable shapes at small sprite size. Small violet status lens in a protected metal recess. Subdued paint, restrained highlights, no toy plastic, no cel outlines. Yuoki visual motifs include circular recessed lid fittings, reinforced box corners, squat pressure domes, flange rings and exposed valve hardware.
One shared family design across all seven depots. Low square base with armored corners, front docking face, a simple inset role-color stripe broad enough to survive a one-third-size preview, small copper couplings, graphite unpainted structure. Freighter will dock beside the station outside its footprint. A short built-in transfer interface stays inside the foundation. Separate paint regions are conceptually main housing, role stripe, and clamps so later grayscale game-tint masks can be made from a 3D master. This image is a review concept with rendered colors and integrated lighting.
Specific depot design
A dry-goods PROVIDER depot. A low massive closed square cargo bunker, reinforced vertical ribs and interlocking roof armor with a large circular recessed mechanical locking seal. Muted brick-red painted role band and roof inset. Front armored shutter opens onto a short recessed outward-loading roller cassette, fully inside the base. A clear chunky outward-facing chevron embossed above the rollers. The silo-like vertical scale is low, approximately as tall as the base is wide. Copper piston latches and orange clamp plates. The closed storage volume is the dominant silhouette.
